pages.body:
components:
  headers:
    CacheControl:
      description: Directives for caching mechanisms. It controls how the response can be cached, by whom, and for how long.
      schema:
        type: string
    ContentLanguage:
      description: The language used in the response.
      schema:
        enum:
          - en
          - de
          - fr
          - ja
          - ru
          - zh
